summary: Stocks are rebounding Monday morning with the Dow up 800 points as oil slides and tech stocks outside Nvidia gain, while Nvidia slides after CEO Jensen Huang apologized for an affair and the board probes a spying case. The VIX is down sharply as fear eases.
